source.method: Original full pages first, student full pages afterward; 2008 is the printed footer despite handwritten year notes.

Q4.style: NP-domino with two static output inverters
Q4.safe_condition: D/f < 2.60 us; f > D/(2.60 us), where D is evaluation duty fraction.
Q4.model: 1 nA total per specified dynamic node; worst adverse direction; linear constant leakage; Cgate1fF and Cdrain0.2fF per device.

Q6.scope: Fixed-threshold long-channel square-law onset, Vout~VDD on rising and~0 on falling; N2/P2 at threshold. Feedback lengths are unprovided; no numerical threshold is selected. Normalized eta samples are algebraic checks, not source values.

Q8a.scope: Linear ON-resistance overwrite approximation; no unprovided Vt is chosen or inferred from inverter trip point. Equal-beta optional pair P=2N does not by itself establish an analog inverter threshold without threshold assumptions.

Q8b.actual_panel: Figure6(b), right upper and lower mux latches; text reference(c) is a typo.
Q8b.upper: low-level, D on port0, noninverting buffer
Q8b.lower: high-level, D on port1, noninverting buffer
Q8b.negative_edge_order: D -> lower high-level master -> upper low-level slave -> Q
Q8b.scope: Ideal latch state phases; no numerical latch delay, overlap or metastability model supplied.

student_comparison.answer.pdf_and_final-answer.pdf: SHA256 identical; one student answer set, not two independent references.
student_comparison.Q4: Node cap counts agree after handwritten correction; uses high-side margin but does not complete low-node/duty-specific frequency analysis.
student_comparison.Q5: Correct setup/hold inequalities, unfinished numerical setup bound; tccq unprovided.
student_comparison.Q6: Begins with internal-node relation but switches to constant-R network and drops threshold; no justified unique N3/P3 dimensions.
student_comparison.Q8: No complete numerical keeper sizing or correctly identified mux-latch edge timing answer is supplied on the two photographed answer pages.

limits: Analytical graph/capacitance/ON-resistance/square-law checks only; no process simulation or layout DRC.
